ModMetaData.name: Nelim's Pickle Tools - Clear screen
ModMetaData.author: Nelim
ModMetaData.description:
Pickle steps that close every window another mod owns and keep them closed for the rest of the scenario, so a click is not swallowed by a log viewer or a notice. Developer tooling; no Defs, no features. A suite stages it with one line in a pass map. See ClearScreen/README.md at the repository root.
It is the same pair of steps as the one proposed to Pickle itself as a pull request; when that lands this mod can go.
Developer test companion for RimWorld 1.6. Requires Pickle; no gameplay content or scenarios included. Enable only for test suites that use these steps. Runtime coverage and limitations are documented in the repository.
